review_kind: author semantic analysis, not independent proof or owner acceptance

comparisons.existing_question: What outcome must one owner-qualified Product enable?
comparisons.distinction_example: Define specifies one particular outcome. The generic Product Capability meaning also covers unrelated outcomes such as work continuity; its separate instance binds the Product and owner.

comparisons.existing_question: What repeatable transformation has explicit steps, roles, gates, evidence and boundaries?
comparisons.distinction_example: Two preparation Methods can realize the same Define outcome; changing a step sequence need not change the capability outcome.

comparisons.existing_question: Which exact technical realization, source version and interfaces are governed?
comparisons.distinction_example: A CLI implementation can be replaced without changing the Define outcome; it may also fail to satisfy that outcome.

comparisons.existing_question: What bounded action or interpretation can an Agent technically attempt?
comparisons.distinction_example: An agent may technically generate text without producing a conforming Pack. Product outcome, technical ability and permission remain distinct.
comparisons.relationship: Product-enabled outcome versus Agent technical ability

comparisons.existing_question: Which concrete time-bounded Agent realization is participating?
comparisons.distinction_example: The ephemeral instance terminates with its Session while a governed Pack can be retained for a later reviewer.
comparisons.relationship: capability outcome versus participating actor instance

comparisons.existing_question: Which owner decision selects how an exact Intent will be addressed?
comparisons.distinction_example: Define can prepare meanings while intent resolution remains pending; preparing those meanings does not appoint the route or prove Intent satisfaction.
comparisons.relationship: meaning preparation versus owner selection decision

comparisons.existing_question: What bounded question, scope and method will a research effort investigate?
comparisons.distinction_example: Research can gather evidence about pagination without a complete meaning-handling bundle. Define organizes required meanings without claiming that incident cause was established.

comparisons.existing_question: How is current work reconstructed across people, sessions and interruptions?
comparisons.distinction_example: Continuity can retain an interrupted Define attempt; preserving it does not turn it into a conforming Define result.
comparisons.relationship: specific meaning outcome versus work continuity

against.standing: authored-unadmitted; not an admitted governing source_ref

comparisons.existing_question: What semantic bundle preserves concept handling for a bounded use?
comparisons.distinction_example: Define is the capability to prepare that bundle. A previously authored Pack may exist without a current Define invocation, while an attempted invocation may fail before producing a conforming Pack.
comparisons.relationship: capability versus result carrier; coupled candidates remain unadmitted

consumer_impacts.required_follow_up: Link the execution review queue; retain the distinction between historical CLI output and future Lab preparation.
Preserve the selected v1 runtime contract. Specify any successor contract, Product binding and source manifest before claiming M1 conformance.
Retain planning draft lineage; bind exact revised candidates in the eventual review package.
